title: Mixture-of-experts serving
brief: Route tokens to top-k experts, dispatch and combine them, count the experts a batch touches, price the all-to-all, and rebalance hot experts.
hints: Softmax over all experts first, then keep the top k and divide by their sum. Skipping the division leaves the weights summing to less than 1.
A capacity drop is decided in token order: for each expert, the first `capacity` (token, slot) pairs in row-major order stay.
A batch of B tokens misses an expert with probability (1 - k/E) per token, so it touches E * (1 - (1 - k/E)^B) experts on average.
The step waits on the busiest rank, so the cost factor is max load over mean load.
